CONCEPT PROJECT / 2026

Foxy

A clever little shake-up for your daily pick-me-up.

Brand identity · Packaging
THE STORY

A world of
its own.

The idea

Foxy is a concept for a ready-to-drink coffee and matcha brand. It explores how personality and playful storytelling can give a familiar product a fresh point of view.

The design

A mischievous fox mascot, expressive typography and energetic colours make every flavour feel distinct. The packaging brings the range together into one recognisable, character-led family.

Self-initiated concept. Presented as a design exploration.
